==English==
{{wp}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|shĭt}}, {{IPA|en|/ʃɪt/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-shit.ogg|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|en-uk-shit.ogg|a=UK}}
* {{audio|en|en-au-shit.ogg|a=AU}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪt|s=1}}

===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|id=noun|:inh|enm:schite|tree=1}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*skey-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|schit}}, {{m|enm|schyt}}, from {{inh|en|ang|*sċite|t=dung}} and {{m|ang|sċitte|t=diarrhoea}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*skiti}} and {{m|gmw-pro|*skittjā}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*skitiz}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*skeyd-|t=to split, divide, separate}}. 

Related to {{cog|stq|Skiete}}, {{cog|fy|skyte}}, {{m|fy|skyt}}, {{cog|nl|schijt}}, {{cog|nds-de|Schiet}}, {{cog|de|Scheiße}}, {{cog|da|skidt}}, {{cog|sv,nn|skit}}, {{cog|nb|skitt}}, {{cog|is|skítur}}. Compare {{m|en|shite}}. {{doublet|en|scheisse}}.

====Alternative forms====
* {{q|[[Appendix:Glossary#bowdlerization|bowdlerizations]]}} {{alt|en|s--t|s**t|s—t}} etc.
* {{alt|en|shite||UK|Ireland}}
* {{alt|en|sheeyit|sheeit|sheit|shiet|shi|shii||AAVE}}
* {{alt|en|shet||dialectal|or|slang}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun|-|s}}
{{tlb|en|vulgar}}

# {{senseid|en|feces}}{{lb|en|countable|uncountable|colloquial|literally}} Usually solid [[excretory]] product evacuated from the [[bowel]]s; [[feces]].
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:feces}}
#: {{ux|en|The field is covered in '''shit'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|He left a '''shit''' in the toilet.}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|title=Cholera and the super-loo|date=30 Jul 2011
|passage=The practice in most African and some Asian cities is for private lorries to suck up human waste and dump it in rivers. [...] In tackling the '''shit''' problem, economics could well be a clincher.}}
# {{lb|en|countable|informal|colloquial|literally}} The act of [[shitting]].
#: {{ux|en|I need to [[take a '''shit''']].}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|colloquial}} [[rubbish|Rubbish]]; [[worthless]] matter.
#: {{syn|en|crap|junk|Thesaurus:trash}}
#: {{ux|en|Throw that '''shit''' out!}}
#: {{ux|en|Get rid of that '''shit'''!}}
#: {{ux|en|Bring that '''shit''' to the disposal.}}
# {{senseid|en|stuff}}{{lb|en|uncountable|colloquial}} [[stuff|Stuff]], [[thing]]s.
#: {{ux|en|I want your '''shit''' out of my garage by tomorrow.}}
#: {{ux|en|Fuck it. I don't feel like doing this '''shit'''.}}
#* {{quote-song|en|year=2001|artist={{w|Mike Cooley (musician)|Mike Cooley}}|title=Zip City|passage=Don't know why I put up with this '''shit''' / When you don't put out and Zip City's so far away}}
#* {{quote-journal|en
|date=December 1, 2017
|author=Tom Breihan
|title=Mad Max: Fury Road might already be the best action movie ever made
|work=w:The Onion AV Club
|url=https://www.avclub.com/mad-max-fury-road-might-already-be-the-best-action-mov-1820691831
|page=
|passage=He’s physical and monosyllabic. He does all sorts of cool '''shit''', and he subtly rediscovers his own heroism without making a big thing out of it. But he’s a supporting character, and he knows it.
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220307045929/https://www.avclub.com/mad-max-fury-road-might-already-be-the-best-action-mov-1820691831}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|colloquial|slang|definite|US}} ('''the shit''') The [[best]] of its kind.
#: {{ux|en|These grapes are the '''shit'''!}}
# {{senseid|en|Q4620674}} {{lb|en|uncountable|slang}} {{U|genitalia}}, especially male.
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:genitalia}}
#: {{coi|en|jerk one's '''shit'''}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|colloquial}} {{U|nonsense}}; [[bullshit]].
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:nonsense}}
#: {{ux|en|Everything he says is a load of '''shit'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Enough of this '''shit'''!}}
#: {{ux|en|Quit your '''shit!'''}}
#: {{ux|en|What is this '''shit?'''}}
#: {{ux|en|Aw, this '''shit''' again?}}
#: {{ux|en|This guy is [[full of shit|full of '''shit''']].}}
# {{lb|en|countable|colloquial}} A [[nasty]], [[despicable]] person, used particularly of men.
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:jerk}}
#: {{ux|en|Her son has been a real '''shit''' to her.}}
#: {{ux|en|I am a '''shit''' and a rotter.}}
#: {{ux|en|Get the fuck out of here you little '''shit!'''}}
#* {{quote-av|en|year=1979|writer=w:Robert Benton|title={{w|Kramer vs. Kramer}}|role=Ted Kramer|actor=w:Dustin Hoffman|passage=…I hate you back, you little '''shit'''!}}
#* {{quote-journal|en
|date=December 1, 2017
|author=Tom Breihan
|title=Mad Max: Fury Road might already be the best action movie ever made
|work=w:The Onion AV Club
|url=https://www.avclub.com/mad-max-fury-road-might-already-be-the-best-action-mov-1820691831
|page=
|passage=(Admittedly, the fact that Steve Mnuchin, Trump’s vampiric treasury secretary, was a Fury Road executive producer complicates this whole parallel. I don’t know what to do with that. Even pieces of '''shit''' can, I suppose, be involved with great things from time to time.)
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220307045929/https://www.avclub.com/mad-max-fury-road-might-already-be-the-best-action-mov-1820691831}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|colloquial|negative polarity}} {{U|anything}}.
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:nothing}}
#: {{uxi|en|We don’t have '''shit''' to live on.|t=We don’t have anything to live on.}}
#: {{uxi|en|John can't sing [[for shit|for '''shit''']].|t=John can't sing at all.}}
#: {{uxi|en|You ain't '''shit'''.|t=You're nothing; you aren't worth anything.}}
# {{lb|en|countable|colloquial}} The smallest amount of [[concern]] or [[consideration]].
#: {{syn|en|fuck|damn}}
#: {{ux|en|I don't [[give a shit|give a '''shit''']].}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|colloquial}} A problem or difficult situation.
#: {{ux|en|I'm in some serious '''shit'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Some '''shit''' went down at the nightclub last night.}}
# {{senseid|en|rebuke}} {{lb|en|uncountable|colloquial}} A strong [[rebuke]].
#: {{ux|en|I gave him '''shit''' for being three hours late twice in one week.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|colloquial}} Any recreational drug (e.g. [[cannabis]], [[heroin]], etc.).
#* {{RQ:Fry Liar|section=I|page=20|passage=‘Now,’ he said, ‘if someone would close the curtains and light a joss-stick, I have here for your delight some twenty-four-carat black Nepalese cannabis resin which should be smoked immediately on account of it being seriously good '''shit'''.’}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|slang}} Anything [[exceptional]] or [[remarkable]].
#: {{usex|en|I heard Bobby escaped from the police by jumping off a bridge into the river. Ain't that some '''shit'''?}}

===Etymology 2===
{{etymon|en|id=verb|:inh|enm:schiten|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|schiten}}, {{m|enm|shiten}}, from {{inh|en|ang|sċītan}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*skītan}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*skītaną}}, from {{inh|en|ine-pro|*skéydt}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*skeyd-}}, {{m|ine-pro|*skeh₁i-d||to cut}} (compare {{m|ine-pro|*skey-}}).

Cognate with {{cog|fy|skite}}, {{cog|nds|schieten}}, {{cog|nl|schijten}}, {{cog|de|scheißen}}, {{cog|da|skide}}. More at {{l|en|shed}}.
